patch.name: video_tests
patch.title: Hidden video test menu
patch.description:
The test mode has a second TEST MENU, of the developers' video tests, that no menu leads to: OBJECT TEST (a viewer of the game's 3D models, among them the tank, the rocket car and the bus of Scud Race Plus), RENDERER, SCROLL, COLOR, FOG/LIGHT, VIEWPORT, LOS, TEXMAP OP, SCALING, POL UPDATE and RESOLUTION TEST. This patch puts it in the place of BOUNDARY SCAN TEST (a test of the board's JTAG chain), as VIDEO TEST MENU.
In OBJECT TEST: Shift up/down change the model (with VR4: fast), accelerator/brake zoom, VR1/VR2 change the rotation, Start resets, VR3 hides the text.
A patch of the program EPROMs (EPR-19688 to EPR-19691), made by Scripts/RomPatches/unlocks.py.
